# MEOK AI Labs — MEOK Compliance Stack

> MEOK (Multimodal Embodied Orchestration Kernel) is a compliance-grade AI agent platform. Built for organisations operating in the EU AI Act, DORA, NIS2, GDPR, ISO 42001, SOC 2, HIPAA, and FDA-regulated environments.

## Core products

- **Sovereign** (£29/mo): consumer-grade AI companion
- **Pro** (£199/mo): compliance + audit logging
- **Enterprise** (£1,499/mo): council-governed PBFT agent fabric
- **Article 50 Kit** (£999 one-time, £499 with LAUNCH50): turnkey EU AI Act watermarking stack — C2PA + SynthID + perceptual fingerprinting + Ed25519 attestations
- **Audit-Prep Bundle** (£4,950): auditor-ready evidence packs
- **CSOAI Watchdog Certification** (£4,950): third-party CEASAI audit

## Compliance MCP Fleet (340+ packages)

- **eu-ai-act-compliance-mcp** — 410 articles from EUR-Lex, FTS5 search, risk classification
- **dora-compliance-mcp** — DORA Regulation 2022/2554
- **nis2-compliance-mcp** — 160k entities, 18 sectors
- **cra-compliance-mcp** — CRA 2024/2847
- **gdpr-compliance-ai-mcp** — DPIA + Art 33 + SCCs
- **iso-42001-ai-mcp** — AI Management System
- **soc2-compliance-ai-mcp** — SOC 2 AI evidence
- **agent-audit-logger-mcp** — hash-chained HMAC-signed audit log
- **ai-bom-mcp** — CycloneDX AI BOM
- **bias-detection-mcp** — fairness metrics
- **meok-council** — 36-node PBFT substrate
- **firmware-attestation-mcp** — firmware attestation

Install: `pip install <package-name>`
Registry: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io

## Key capabilities

- **Article 50 watermarking**: C2PA manifest + SynthID-class invisible watermark + perceptual fingerprinting
- **Audit trail**: hash-chained HMAC-signed audit log for every tool call
- **Council governance**: 36-node PBFT council with Ed25519 signing
- **EU AI Act classifier**: 9 in-scope Articles (4, 6, 9, 10, 14, 26(9), 43, 50, 72) all signed, all auditor-verifiable

## Article 50 cliff

The EU AI Act Article 50 (transparency + watermarking) applies **2 August 2026** for new AI systems, **2 December 2026** for pre-existing systems. Applies to ALL AI systems, not high-risk-only. Default SynthID-only or C2PA-only approaches FAIL the EU Code of Practice (requires ≥2 layers).
